notes: All 12 views inspected. Rejected on third-party-rights grounds. A zoomed crop of the front bezel shows a circular badge built from a red upper arc, a blue lower arc and a white central band carrying lettering. That construction closely imitates the Pepsi globe trade dress, and substituting an invented word does not cure the imitation. Under the library's standing marks policy a device that mimics a famous trademark is refused even though the asset is CC0, because CC0 waives copyright only and grants no trademark clearance. The mesh itself is otherwise clean.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
